text: The Chardonnay Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola deck is the strongest Arena deck since 10-08.
detail: 23.2% of crumb.gg's sample; 'a high-star Bari-Oven deck is simply the strongest'. Chardonnay takes Macaron's slot.

text: Chardonnay replaces Macaron in every deck: the crit buffs don't stack.
detail: Even a low-star Chardonnay beats Macaron in Arena; an 18M Chardonnay Rye deck beat the Macaron one at 30M.

text: Rye decks now lose to Bari from about 5★; Rye is the pick only below that.
detail: Rye's plan was to outlast the opening; Chardonnay's crit flood ends the fight first.

text: Bari under 5★: play the same deck with Rye for Cherry Cola.
detail: 서신우's guide; his Rye version won at 32.82M against 34.51M.

text: Keep crit RES on the bottom-left: Chardonnay pushes crit past 100% into higher crit tiers.
detail: Disputed: some move to evasion + DR. Against very high crit, DR pays more.

text: Haste is argued: Bari decks mostly run zero, 서신우's crit RES preset runs six.
detail: One Bari player wins more on six; Rye decks run three to six.

text: Chardonnay runes: all Skill AMP. Her crit buff scales; push RES doesn't.
Pomegranate's beam goes to Chardonnay and Milk first; keep Bari or Oven next in ATK.
Defenses keep losing to equal attackers: attack late and farm revenges.
detail: Revenges cost no gems and hide the attack deck. The new help text on perks isn't captured.

text: Keep an accuracy preset: evasion decks are the only hope against 10★ Bari and still reach Grand Master.
Captain Milk at merc Lv.4 with Armor Repair + Passion Pay; keep her in mirrors.
detail: Armor Repair needs three tanks. Fights against weaker teams often end before her first heal.

text: Skip the Eternal Lv.95 package: its pieces are fixed at Lv.95 with set lines.
Season 2's top 100 run the charge core with Chardonnay for Macaron.
detail: 29 of 52 fully revealed teams are exactly the Chardonnay 12; Chardonnay on 85, Macaron on 5.

text: Season 2 kept Season 1's buff: Charge +30% HP, everyone +30% DR.
detail: So the charge core survived; the 10-07 question is settled.

text: Herb or Rockstar in the flex; the #1 runs no Herb.
detail: Rockstar is on 14 of 52 fully revealed top-100 teams and 26 of the top 100.

text: Pets: King Choco Drop and Holy Baby Drop, plus Icy Birdie or Hot Doggie.
detail: #1 and #3 run Floral Froglet + Fluffy Cheese Cat: Bari and Oven are Fire.

text: Rye decks win mid-ladder at best; Rye is on 8 of the top 100.
detail: A 25M Bari deck killed a 30M Rye deck at the start.

text: Carry two accuracy lines or the stage preset: evasion defenses spread higher up.
Defenses hide 2–4 cookies by league: read the visible core and assume the Chardonnay 12.
Top-100 rewards need 3,000 points; Season 1's 100th finished near 3,805.
detail: Ranks 101 to ~2,300 shared Elite Master 1 rewards. The shop resets every two seasons.
